dex.entry: A little two-faced tumbler that lives in the Old Light's halls. One half of it is bright and grinning, the other half dark and deadpan, and it only ever finishes half a joke: the bright side tells the setup, the dark side forgets the punchline. It practises its tumbles all night where nobody can see

art.silhouette: A small round-bodied jester kin split straight down the middle: the left half cream-white with a gold diamond motley and a bright grinning eye, the right half deep indigo-black with a silver diamond and a sleepy deadpan eye. A two-pointed jester cap, one point gold with a tiny lit bell, one point indigo with a dark bell. Stubby arms, curly-toed shoes, a ruffled collar half gold, half indigo. At 64px it reads instantly as a cute half-light, half-dark harlequin ball.

art.direction: Cheerful, mischievous, a little incomplete — always half a joke short. Cute, never creepy; the split must be clean and readable.
